scope: Independent bridges beyond the first five expedition routes. Existing clones were read-only. No astronomical data fit, public posting, or new fundamental-physics claim.

status_definitions.established_result: A known mathematical or physical result within its stated assumptions.
status_definitions.conditional_model: A calculation applying a specified dynamical model and parameter regime; its use for actual dark matter remains conditional.
status_definitions.untested_conjecture: An idea requiring a new action-specific derivation, evolution calculation, or observation.
status_definitions.own_inference: A connection, proposed next probe, or independently derived teaching example from this pass.
status_definitions.repository_claim: What a source repository says; not independently established by its inclusion here.

literature.title: Gauge Kinematics of Deformable Bodies
literature.reading: Search-indexed abstract and opening discussion. Downloaded scan, visually inspected printed page 452 (PDF page 4), equations 2.1-2.6.
literature.supports: Shape deformation can reconstruct a net orientation change under zero-angular-momentum constraints. The geometric reconstruction is invariant under retiming the prescribed path.
literature.limits: Prescribing shape changes does not supply their energy, actuators or free-body dynamics. Gauge formulation does not make all physics one mechanism.

literature.title: The Geometric Phase of the Three-Body Problem
literature.reading: Full-text sections 1.1-1.2, 2.6, and portions of sections 3-4 and the Jacobi-coordinate appendix. Read reconstruction equation 2 and connection A = II^-1 J.
literature.supports: A return in triangle shape admits orientation reconstruction with dynamical and geometric terms. Zero-angular-momentum infinitesimal deformations define horizontal directions.
literature.limits: The report's prescribed loop is a pedagogical kinematic example, not a newly solved Newtonian orbit. General spatial and nonzero-angular-momentum formulas require their own conventions.

literature.title: Quantal phase factors accompanying adiabatic changes
literature.reading: Indexed abstract and introduction; visually inspected printed pages 46-47, equations 1-10, from the author's scanned copy.
literature.supports: An adiabatically cycled isolated eigenstate acquires geometric and dynamical phase contributions. The geometric contribution is a circuit integral and can be observed relative to a reference through interference.
literature.limits: The elementary formula needs the adiabatic and isolated-level assumptions. Degeneracies, decoherence and nonadiabatic transitions need further treatment. No black-hole-cloud geometric-phase observation is asserted.

literature.title: Vortices and waves in light dark matter
literature.reading: Full-text introduction including action 1.1 and nonrelativistic equation 1.3; section 2.2 equations 2.3-2.8; selected section 3 examples; numerical diagnostic discussion in section 5; section 7 equation 7.1 and surrounding angular-momentum discussion.
literature.supports: Phase zeros in a nonrelativistic scalar support quantized circulation. Simulated halos with zero net angular momentum can have vortex rings, and vortex-free wave configurations can carry angular momentum. The paper explicitly distinguishes its negligible-self-interaction regime from earlier condensate equilibrium studies.
literature.limits: Conditional scalar dark-matter model. No observed halo vortex is established. Its kinetic term and phase variable are not automatically those of AeST or ghost condensates.
literature.version_note: Read v2 HTML. Its abstract's mass threshold differs from later/default abstract text, so the report does not use either mass-threshold number.

literature.title: Angular Momentum and Vortex Formation in Bose-Einstein-Condensed Cold Dark Matter Haloes
literature.reading: v4 abstract, sections 3.2 and 4-related passages, equations 85-100 and 108-109, conclusion discussion of interaction-dependent vortex energetics.
literature.supports: A rotating equilibrium condensate can energetically favor a vortex for specified interaction and angular-momentum conditions. Non-axisymmetric irrotational Riemann-S figures can carry angular momentum.
literature.limits: Approximate equilibrium halo models and restricted interaction regimes. The statement about absent vortices for vanishing interaction is not a theorem excluding transient interference zeros in all scalar fields. No formation-rate or halo-observation result is adopted here.

literature.title: Electromagnetic Traps for Charged and Neutral Particles
literature.type: Primary Nobel lecture by the technique's inventor
literature.reading: Pages 603-610: Laplace condition, alternating quadrupole fields, Mathieu equations, stability regions, secular motion and micromotion. PDF text retrieved and local copy downloaded.
literature.supports: A static quadrupole is a saddle; alternating focusing can confine motion within specified stability regions. Stabilization is a dynamical effect with continued micromotion.
literature.limits: The local Floquet example is dimensionless and idealized. It omits electrode boundaries, finite amplitudes, noise, many-body effects and cooling.
literature.access_note: Official Nobel PDF returned HTTP 403. A university-hosted copy of the same primary lecture was used.

literature.title: The Maxwell Conjecture is False
literature.type: Primary preprint, limited verification in this pass
literature.supports: The literature lead cited by point-charges exists and its abstract states a five-charge construction with at least 24 nondegenerate critical points.
literature.limits: Proof not reviewed here. The expedition does not independently certify or endorse the repository's count results. This source is context, not needed for the support no-go derivation.

repository_material.use: Identifies the proposed irrotational-scalar collapse and nonradiating-fluid mechanism that needs action-specific angular-momentum and circulation analysis. Its universal post-caustic heating assertions are not accepted as established physics.
Connects superfluid circulation and wave support to the new diagnostic questions. No claim of observed gravitational atoms or dark-matter vortices is taken from the repository.
Supplies the charge-equilibrium, relative-equilibrium and orbit-certification questions. Existing counts and certificates were not independently rerun.

Recurring eclipses and changing viewing geometry motivate keeping recurrence and orientation distinct. Archival findings and predicted dates were not revalidated. No geometric-phase explanation is assigned to a particular star.

repository_material.reading: README and NOTE sections 1, 2 and 4, including the harmonic no-extremum statement, Morse-index table and verification scope.
repository_material.use: Confirms the project already records the support/stability distinction and Morse indices. This expedition is not finding an omitted theorem in that project.
repository_material.limits: Live main was not pinned to a commit. Local README snapshot retained; no certifier executed.

local_results_and_inferences.claim: A prescribed, internally actuated three-mass loop gives a 27-degree orientation change at zero total angular momentum.
local_results_and_inferences.limit: Known kinematic effect, not a free gravitational orbit or new physical discovery.

local_results_and_inferences.claim: Explicit normalizable fields separate nonzero angular momentum without vortices from opposite vortices with zero total angular momentum.
checks: phase-winding loops around each defect and both
local_results_and_inferences.limit: Two-dimensional initial snapshots only. Neither stationarity, formation, lifetime, halo realism nor AeST applicability is asserted.

local_results_and_inferences.claim: Static triangle force balance is a saddle; an ideal alternating quadrupole is linearly stable for one selected frequency and unstable for another.
local_results_and_inferences.limit: Numerical linear stability check for a specified imposed field. No rigorous interval certificate or nonlinear experimental trap design is supplied.

local_results_and_inferences.claim: An angular-momentum and circulation audit may distinguish nonlinear dark-field collapse mechanisms that an energy-only argument leaves ambiguous.
local_results_and_inferences.required_work: Derive quantities and boundary fluxes from the actual intended action; choose admissible initial data; compare nonlinear evolution beyond one dimension.
local_results_and_inferences.limit: No claim that vortex formation or a particular transport law occurs in AeST.

local_results_and_inferences.claim: In a Newtonian point-mass potential, minimum orbital energy at fixed specific angular momentum j occurs at the circular radius j^2/(GM).
local_results_and_inferences.derivation: Minimize effective potential j^2/(2r^2)-GM/r with respect to r. Its derivative vanishes at r=j^2/(GM) and its second derivative there is positive.
local_results_and_inferences.limit: A point-mass potential and test matter are assumed. For actual extended self-gravitating systems the potential, stresses and angular-momentum transport must be derived.
